rachel: Quick plan idea for Ember launch: 120 starter credits + a 'starter prompts' pack. tiny live demo Wed, then replay gated. Goal: measure 72h activation and prompt reuse. keep it tight.

 tom: split the experiment 2x: A) credits only, B) credits + prompts + 2-step nudge. simple and clean.

 isabel: for routing, tag inbound signups as ember_experiment. route >10-seat workspaces to sales; others to nurture. also add support alert on credit claims.

 neil: timeline: creative by Mon, cohort seed Tue morning, webinar Wed 11am PT. experiment_id=ember_q2_small, arms=[ctrl_credits, prompts_nudge], primary=72h_active_pct. i'll set cohort caps to NA/EU.

 rachel: nudges: Day0 email + promptpack, Day2 in-app tip. reward at Day4 with extra 50 credits if they run 3 prompts. opt-out on all emails.

 tom: creative needs: 2 social cards, 30s demo clip, email hero. headline test: "Ship faster with Ember prompts" vs "Starter prompts for fast demos".

 publish-bot: scheduled social post "Ember launch demo + starter credits" for 2025-05-07T18:00:00Z.

 isabel: measurement note: capture `prompt.install` and `credit.redeem` events, and set attribution UTMs. I'll add routing rules to CRM.

 rachel: ok folks. next actions: tom -> creative, neil -> cohort + tracking, isabel -> routing + support alert. sync Tue 09:30 PT. thanks! :rocket:
